package.name: delay_relay
package.description: ROS 2 package for MMT setups. - delay_relay_node : forwards Float64MultiArray after a configurable delay. - init_node : drives the local arm to the remote arm's joint positions via a proportional velocity controller, then destroys the publisher once converged. - forward_torque_delay_relay_node : delayed joint-state PD tracking for Franka forward_torque_controller command topics. - forward_torque_init_node : torque-based PD initialization for the Franka/model forward_torque_controller setup.
